name: arthendain
description: Arthendain (Fall from Heaven), the dwarf hero and healer of the Runes of Kilmorph: short, broad and stocky, a big red-orange beard and moustache with braids, a brown leather cap with a gold band, gold-scaled leather armour over a brown leather jerkin, a pale cloth-wrapped right shoulder and upper arm, a brown belt with a square gold buckle, a pouch stuffed with green healing herbs at his hip on the screen-left side, brown leather boots; he holds a big wooden crossbow with a gold-studded stock and a steel-tipped bolt level, pointing to the right, its stock gripped in his RIGHT hand and its fore-end steadied by his LEFT hand
hands: the crossbow stays in his right hand gripping the stock on the screen-left side; at rest his left hand on the screen-right side also holds the crossbow under its fore-end, and during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, the arms jerk (the crossbow jolted in his right hand but still pointing to the right, its front end dipping; the empty left fist pulled in just under it), the red beard swinging
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the crossbow held level at his belly, still pointing to the right, the empty left fist under it
flinch.2: recovering: halfway back to the ready pose, the crossbow level and pointing to the right, the left hand reaching back toward its fore-end

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the crossbow flung up above his head in the right hand, still pointing to the right, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the capped head and red beard droop, the crossbow sagging to waist height, still pointing to the right
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the front of the crossbow resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crossbow slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the red beard on his chest; the crossbow lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the braided red beard settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the red beard on his chest, the crossbow on the ground beside him
